pull_request.body:
## Goal
Prototype the smallest no-API/no-Work bootstrap discovered in the 2026-08-29 physical probes:

`Windows Task Scheduler -> fresh run-id-bound deep link -> fresh ordinary Chat -> Chat Local Bridge Test -> one bounded Send -> bridge call`

## Research gates
- `project-context/CHATGPT_DEEPLINK_AUTOSEND_RESEARCH.md` -> **NARROW**
- `project-context/CHATGPT_DEEPLINK_SCHEDULER_RESEARCH.md` -> **NARROW** after the browser autosend physical pass

The scheduler slice remains one-shot/experimental only. No recurrence, WorkingState lease, worker rotation, automatic retry, production scheduler authority, paid API, Work, Computer Use, or Codex automation is introduced.

## Physical evidence observed
### Browser autosend gate
Target-browser probe on 2026-08-29:

`fresh ordinary Chat -> plugin chip -> extension autosend -> Chat Local Bridge Test.workspace_read exactly once -> DEEPLINK_AUTOSEND_BRIDGE=PASS`

### One-shot scheduler gate
Target-Windows physical probe on 2026-08-29 also passed end-to-end without a user click after registration:

`Task Scheduler -> launcher -> default HTTPS browser (Google Chrome on target Windows) -> fresh ordinary Chat -> automatic Send -> Chat Local Bridge Test.workspace_read exactly once -> DEEPLINK_SCHEDULED_BRIDGE=PASS`

Observed run id:

`CAP_AUTOSEND_RUN_ID=autosend-0c2a2662f54447eea18c153a698d4ffb`

The target machine's HTTPS association was explicitly changed from Edge to Google Chrome before this successful probe. The launcher itself intentionally delegates HTTPS to the user's default browser rather than owning browser selection.

## Implementation
### Browser extension
- Manifest V3 static content script only on `https://chatgpt.com/*`.
- No extension `permissions`, `host_permissions`, background worker, network API, native messaging, Work/Codex/API usage, or Local Bridge calls.
- Requires `cap_autosend=1`, a fresh non-secret `cap_run_id`, matching visible `CAP_AUTOSEND_RUN_ID=<run-id>`, expected `Chat Local Bridge Test`, and an enabled reviewed Send control.
- Writes an at-most-one marker before one `button.click()`; ambiguity never triggers same-run retry.

### Windows one-shot launcher/scheduler
- `launch-chatgpt-deeplink-autosend.ps1` generates a fresh run id at execution time, owns the sentinel, URL-encodes the prompt, and delegates the HTTPS URI to the user's default browser.
- `register-chatgpt-deeplink-autosend-probe.ps1` registers one `-Once -At` Task Scheduler trigger for the current user with `Interactive` logon, `Limited` run level, `IgnoreNew` multiple-instance policy, and a 2-minute process execution bound.
- The scheduled action invokes PowerShell with process-local `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`; the repository does not change machine/user execution policy.
- A separate prompt body fixture performs one `workspace_read` bridge probe.

## Hosted tests
- manifest/policy tests for the extension;
- JavaScript syntax/policy execution through Node;
- PowerShell parse under central CI;
- Windows launcher URL-binding test with `-NoLaunch`;
- forged run-id sentinel rejection;
- scheduler dry-run contract for interactive/limited/one-shot behavior;
- static regression against recurring trigger forms.

## Scope boundary / next stage
Both experimental physical gates have now passed. This PR still does **not** authorize recurring autonomous wake/resume.

The next stage is separate fresh Stage Research for production WorkingState resume + bounded wake ownership/lease semantics, including failure/crash analysis before implementation. Do not generalize this one-shot probe into recurrence, automatic retry, worker rotation, or production scheduler authority inside this PR.

Before merge, complete required exact-head hosted CI and fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review under `.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`.
